boundary.zh: Pinhere v1 的完整 REST API，包含项目与 Origin、缺陷内容和状态流转、私有截图、Webhook 与投递诊断、PAT，以及 Chrome 扩展 OAuth 2.0 PKCE；共 34 个接口和 36 个 Schema。
boundary.en: The complete Pinhere v1 REST API for projects and origins, issue content and lifecycle transitions, private screenshots, webhooks and delivery diagnostics, PATs, and Chrome-extension OAuth 2.0 PKCE, comprising 34 Endpoints and 36 Schemas.

blockers.zh: 公共产品仓库未声明 LICENSE 或其他可核验的再分发条款。不得把产品自有 PontxSpec、其双语副本、生成 SDK/CLI 或产品 Skill 作为正式 Pontx 产品发布。
blockers.en: The public product repository declares no LICENSE or other verifiable redistribution terms. The product-owned PontxSpec, bilingual copies, generated SDK/CLI, and product Skill must not be published as an admitted Pontx product.

blockers.zh: 设计目标域名 pinhere.dev 尚未绑定，https://pinhere.dev/.well-known/pontx.json 不可用；现有 Vercel Preview 不是 canonical 生产地址。@pontx/pinhere 与 pontx-pinhere 只能保持本地 private/UNLICENSED RC，不得发布到 npm。
blockers.en: The intended pinhere.dev domain is not bound and https://pinhere.dev/.well-known/pontx.json is unavailable; the current Vercel Preview is not a canonical production address. @pontx/pinhere and pontx-pinhere may remain only a local private/UNLICENSED release candidate and must not be published to npm.

nextAction.zh: 由 Pinhere 所有者选择并提交明确许可证，绑定 pinhere.dev，并使正式发现地址返回与固定 source hash 一致的 PontxSpec；随后完成独立 SDK 仓库、Node 18/20/22 CI、npm registry 复验、正式 Metadata/Skill、Preview 与 Production 上线。生产 Hobby cron 当前仅每日 00:00 UTC 运行一次；除非计划升级，不得把五分钟自动重试描述为已上线能力。
nextAction.en: The Pinhere owner must select and commit an explicit license, bind pinhere.dev, and serve a PontxSpec matching the pinned source hash from the canonical discovery URL. Then complete the independent SDK repository, Node 18/20/22 CI, npm registry verification, admitted Metadata/Skill, Preview, and Production rollout. The production Hobby cron currently runs only once daily at 00:00 UTC; do not describe five-minute automatic retries as deployed unless the plan is upgraded.
